title: Is LLM an Overconfident Judge? Unveiling the Capabilities of LLMs in Detecting Offensive Language with Annotation Disagreement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating binary classification accuracy on offensive versus non-offensive language across varying degrees of human annotation agreement, demonstrating that models disproportionately misclassify ambiguous, low-agreement non-offensive samples as offensive.

Estimating model confidence using a self-consistency method across varying temperature settings and comparing these confidence scores against human annotation agreement levels (soft labels) using Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Spearman's Rank Correlation.
